style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh home-gardening ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep garden green #2E7D5B, soft mist white #F5F8F5, charcoal text #33383D and one fresh leaf-green accent #7FC79B; bright soft studio lighting with a gentle upper-front key and soft natural shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headline type; consistent rounded-rectangle labels and rounded white info cards; consistent thin-line icon style with small soft-focus green leaves as corner accents; clean natural product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; product standing upright with stable scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: product standing upright, stable slight 3/4 or frontal hero angle, consistent scale across the set, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
